glossEn: a farm building for housing horses or other livestock
note: a farm building for housing horses or other livestock。线索：horse / cattle + stable。

glossEn: resistant to change of position or condition / firm and dependable; subject to little fluctuation
note: resistant to change of position or condition / firm and dependable; subject to little fluctuation。线索：price / economy / relationship。可作褒义（可靠）也可作中性（不变）。
shelter in a stable。动词义，极罕见（实际英语几乎都用 stable the horses 的复合动词）。
